event_summary: US Congressman Ro Khanna says armed Israeli settlers and soldiers detained him during a visit to the occupied West Bank, and he accuses the Israeli military of lying about what happened.

Lindsey Graham, a long-serving Republican US senator from South Carolina and a close ally of Donald Trump, has died at 71 after a brief and sudden illness, setting off tributes and a scramble over his Senate seat.
US Senator Mitch McConnell breaks weeks of silence to explain that a fall, plus mild pneumonia, put him in hospital and kept him away from Congress.
South Korea's exports jumped almost 54% in the first ten days of July compared with a year earlier, driven mainly by a surge in semiconductor shipments, according to customs data.
South Korea's Kospi index dropped into a bear market as investors grew nervous about AI chipmakers, even as SK hynix pulled off a record $26.5bn US listing days earlier.

The European Commission said Meta's Facebook and Instagram break EU digital rules because their addictive design, such as infinite scroll and autoplay, pushes users, especially teenagers, into compulsive use. Meta could face fines of up to 6% of its global revenue.
China recovered an orbital rocket booster for the first time, catching it in a net at sea instead of landing it on legs.
Korean fashion brand Matin Kim is reportedly teaming up with the KBO baseball club LG Twins for a baseball-themed collection launching July 20.
A fire tore through a popular pub in the Chatuchak district of Bangkok, killing at least 27 people and injuring dozens more.
The United States launched a new wave of strikes on Iran and insisted the Strait of Hormuz stayed open to shipping, while Iran said it had closed the vital waterway.
